nonclaims: Coverage reduction withholds combinations; it does not create new chemistry. A coverage curve measures reuse of observed molecular factors, not extrapolation to chemistry absent from the corpus.
S1 is in-sample and may never be reported as a generalization result.
not_the_purpose: cross-role coupling, which the corpus audit showed is absent: component identities pair near-independently and the aldehyde-by-isocyanide grid is fully saturated
purpose: does experimentally grounded semantic organization let a generator reuse molecular knowledge across an incompletely observed combinatorial product space

reserved_holdouts.policy: excluded from every coverage subset, so library extrapolation is separable from combination novelty

strata_definitions.S1_in_sample: inside the training subset; a fidelity control, not generalization
strata_definitions.S2_fixed_combination_test: the subset of S2 lying in the fixed combination test set, withheld from every coverage level. This is the primary endpoint for the coverage curve, because it is the same test set at every training size.
strata_definitions.S2_new_combination: combination absent from the subset, all three components present in it; grows as coverage falls
strata_definitions.S3_held_component_identity: one component identity reserved out, family retained
strata_definitions.S4_held_component_family: one component family reserved out; the harder shift
strata_definitions.S5_unseen_component_not_reserved: component absent from the subset by coverage reduction rather than by reservation; reported separately so it cannot be read as either S2 or S3
